title: Edit an AI Studio project
blurb: Change words, images and colours by chatting, clicking or editing code.

steps.title: Open AI Studio
steps.body: Click **AI Studio** in the left menu.

steps.title: Open your project
steps.body: Go to **My Projects** and open the one you want to change.

steps.title: Ask in plain words
steps.body: The quickest way is the chat: "swap the hero photo for this one", "change the phone number to 0800 123 456".

steps.title: Click to edit
steps.body: Use **Visual Edits** to click any text, image or button and change it directly.

steps.title: Fine-tune the code
steps.body: Comfortable with code? **Code Editor** lets you make exact changes. Most people never need it.
